interpretation: Per-launch medians and twelve samples are kept separately. Allocation reduction in XLS is repeatable; timing movement in unchanged lanes is not attributed to the patch. Profiles are diagnostic and do not supply these timing results.

verification.heavy_run_policy: Every build, publish, test, diagnostic workload and benchmark runs under the shared lock; MSBuild and native compilation at most two workers.
limits: Single M4 host, ordinary OS scheduling; timing variation retained.
net472 cross-build only; no Windows runtime test in this cohort.
